author: master-designer
status: proposal, not approved. Do not change binding docs or v3 outputs. Clay comparison only.

conventions.axes: Same as v3 / skeleton: metres, origin on the floor at the back wall on the sofa axis of v3, X right as the main camera sees, Y from back wall toward the camera, Z up. Left-handed; the v3 rig mirrors the camera (scale.x = -1).
conventions.yaw_deg_left: Camera heading measured from -Y, positive = turned toward -X (left of frame). Forward f = (-sin(yaw), -cos(yaw), 0); right r = (cos(yaw), -sin(yaw), 0).
conventions.shift: u0, v0 = principal point (frame fractions, v from top). v0 = 0.5 + shift_y * 16/9 (v3: shift_y -0.0625 -> v0 0.3889). |shift_x| = |u0 - 0.5|; with the mirrored v3 rig, u0 > 0.5 needs shift_x < 0. Verify both by projecting the optical axis, as the v3 self-check does.
conventions.chair_yaw: Same convention as build_scene.py CHAIR.yaw_deg: -25 = chair faces +X, turned 25 deg toward the back wall.
conventions.positions_status: fixed furniture, shell and camera are firm for the comparison. Slot proxies marked provisional are indicative and will be finalised in the scene brief after the user picks.
